create_SubgraphProfiler: create a SubgraphProfiler instance with num_ens and metrics dict specifying running and global metrics
update_subgraph_batch: update the SubgraphProfiler with a subgraph batch to queue for profiling
profile_subgraph_metrics: profile subgraph hops and sizes metrics across ensemble members using the SubgraphProfiler
summarize_profiled_metrics: summarize collected subgraph profile metrics and return aggregated statistics per ensemble member
print_profile_summary: print a formatted summary of subgraph profile statistics including hops and sizes
